basePrompt: Use case sketch-to-render. Transform this exact SketchUp view into high-quality photoreal architectural visualization. Preserve exact camera perspective, composition, complete silhouette, all roof intersections, openings and mullion counts, porch and columns, trims, foundation heights, grading and hardscape boundaries. Do not redesign. Materials must follow image placements faithfully: grey asphalt shingle roof, black soffit/fascia; warm pale greige Cobble Stone horizontal lap siding and trims; Sand Dunes US Brick pale sandy-grey brick; Eden Machine Cut Veneer light warm grey/beige stone with irregular rectangular texture, keep stone distinct from fine brick; light brown wood-tone decorative horizontal infill panels, light brown front and garage doors, black windows and patio door frames. Retain source window trim/sill dimensions. Natural daylight and subtle soft shadows, realistic glass with sky reflections and subdued interiors. Replace ONLY dark olive ground surfaces with realistic closely mown green grass following exact grade. Preserve all grey paved surfaces, driveways, entry apron, steps and wood decks exactly, no grass on them. Surroundings only grass and light blue sky with soft clouds, NO trees, shrubs, flowerbeds, cars, people, fences except existing deck railings. No added paving, no camera change, no text, no watermark. Keep house fully visible, same framing, add only slight margin if needed. Model v3 overrides generic schedule where applicable: roof soffit undersides and thin under-eave frieze boards are Arctic White; fascia remains black. Entry tower roof is dark standing seam metal where visible; other roofs shingles.
